exam_rules: Exams are taken online via the Meta Certification Testing Platform (PSI). Online proctoring is available; a webcam and microphone are required. No open-book materials permitted during the exam. Candidates must agree to Meta's certification terms and code of conduct. Scores are reported on a 1000-point scale; passing score is 700.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name on ID must match the name on the exam registration. A Meta/Facebook account is required to register.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-15: Meta Blueprint's Marketing Science Professional page is live ('The exam has 60 questions and is 90 minutes long', 'Register for the exam here').

prerequisites.description: Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate recommended; strong analytics background recommended

renewal_options: Certifications expire after 1 year. Renewal requires passing the current version of the exam. Meta may update exams annually to reflect platform changes.

retake_policy.notes: Candidates must wait 30 days before retaking a failed exam. Each retake requires full repayment of the exam fee.
